analysis: This remains the clearest injury-driven read on the board. Sam Darnold is now CONFIRMED active and starting for Seattle -- HC Macdonald says he is fully ready, glute resolved -- clearing the one lingering question mark on Seattles side. Working against Seattle: starting safeties Julian Love (calf) and Ty Okada (hamstring, his 3rd straight missed game) are both confirmed OUT, with AJ Finley and Rodney Thomas II stepping in. Net of both moves, the model margin actually widened, not narrowed -- Seattle now projects as a 14.5-point favorite against Washington, well past even Caesars aggressive +8.5 and far past DraftKings still-lagging +6.5.

Jayden Daniels remains confirmed out with Marcus Mariota starting for Washington -- unchanged and still the dominant driver. With DK sitting nearly 2 points behind Caesars and the model number even bigger than that, this is the single highest-conviction spread lean on the board this week.
